user.title: Brother Label Printer
user.description: Connect a compatible Brother P-touch network printer. Setup checks TCP connectivity without printing, then detects the model over SNMP.

model.title: Printer model
model.description: Detected model: {detected_model}. Leave the override blank to use automatic detection. An override only changes the displayed model name; it does not add support for other printers.

reconfigure.title: Edit printer settings
reconfigure.description: Change the printer address, port, default tape width or model-name override. Clear the override to restore automatic model detection. A changed address/port is checked before saving.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the printer. Check its address and power.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Brother label printer is supported.
